tasks.title: Telegram client + long-polling loop: getUpdates with offset, dedup, per-chat queue, photo/document pick, getFile download, magic-byte + 10 MB validation, sendMessage/typing, 409 handling

verification.purpose: The poller requests getUpdates with offset last update id plus one and a repeated update id is processed only once
Two photos from the same chat are handled in arrival order, one at a time
A file whose magic bytes are not JPEG, PNG or WebP, or larger than 10 MB, is rejected before any backend call even when its name or MIME claims an image
A photo and an image document are both picked; edited messages and non-message updates are ignored
A 409 Conflict from getUpdates is logged and retried with backoff without crashing the poller
The typing action is sent before the long count call starts
